description: The record kinds a local outlet prints as briefs, a headline and one line in its side column (owner, Oct 29: side stories for realism, "a line or two"; OWNER-DECISIONS Oct 29 17:40 UTC). Each is a record the town keeps; the desk prints those its reporters left, by its own score, up to the outlet's space (briefsPerOutletWeek), and none when the town recorded none. The wording marks each brief: true (src/english/english-newscast.ts). The town-wide kinds (townWide) name no one and are the whole town's, so they involve every follower, as a law in force does; reporters never take a brief kind as their story.
